criticalIssues.title: Weak Authorization Check in Relay Endpoint
criticalIssues.description: isAuthorized = (secret === process.env.DEVICE_SECRET && process.env.DEVICE_SECRET) - If DEVICE_SECRET is empty or falsy, authorization is bypassed
criticalIssues.impact: Attackers can send relay messages without proper authentication
criticalIssues.recommendation: Add length check and typeof validation: typeof secret === 'string' && secret.length > 0 && secret === process.env.DEVICE_SECRET

criticalIssues.title: simulateInbound Endpoint Missing Authentication
criticalIssues.description: The simulateInbound endpoint has NO authentication middleware - allows any unauthenticated user to create fake inbound messages
criticalIssues.impact: Attackers can create fake SMS/chat messages for any profile, disrupting operations
criticalIssues.recommendation: Add authMiddleware to the route: router.post('/simulate-inbound', authMiddleware, messageController.simulateInbound)

criticalIssues.title: Insufficient Command Injection Protection in SSH
criticalIssues.description: SSH execCommand with incomplete blocked list. Missing: chmod, chown, tee, nc, pipe operators
criticalIssues.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary commands on VPS, leading to full system compromise
criticalIssues.recommendation: Implement whitelist of allowed commands only. Use parameterized execution.

criticalIssues.title: Sensitive Data Logging - JWT Tokens & Credentials
criticalIssues.description: Logs full request headers and body: console.warn(...Headers: ${JSON.stringify(req.headers)}, Body: ${JSON.stringify(req.body)})
criticalIssues.impact: JWT tokens, API keys, and passwords exposed in logs which may be centrally stored/monitored
criticalIssues.recommendation: Create sanitizeHeaders/sanitizeBody functions to remove Authorization, X-API-Key, passwords before logging

criticalIssues.title: Path Traversal Risk in Git Pull
criticalIssues.description: repoPath from request body is not validated. Allows: ../../../etc, /root/.ssh, /var/www
criticalIssues.impact: Attackers can read/write arbitrary files on the server
criticalIssues.recommendation: Validate path with path.resolve() and check against whitelist. Only allow specific directories.

criticalIssues.title: Silent Error Handling in Auth Middleware
criticalIssues.description: Generic catch block without logging error details hides JWT verification failures
criticalIssues.impact: Cannot diagnose authentication attacks or debug legitimate JWT issues
criticalIssues.recommendation: Log error type and message: catch (err) { logger.warn('[Auth] JWT failed', {errorType: err.name, ip: req.ip}); }

highIssues.title: Unhandled Promise in SIP Config Regeneration
highIssues.description: regenerateAsteriskConfig().then().catch() - user receives 200 OK even if regeneration fails
highIssues.impact: Silent failures leave SIP configuration inconsistent, breaking VoIP functionality
highIssues.recommendation: Use async/await with proper error handling. Communicate results back to client.

highIssues.title: Missing Null Check on req.user
highIssues.description: req.user.id accessed without checking if req.user exists
highIssues.impact: Potential TypeError: Cannot read property 'id' of undefined

highIssues.title: Unsafe Property Access on req.user.role
highIssues.description: req.user.role.isManager accessed without null/undefined check on role
highIssues.impact: TypeError if role is null or middleware skipped

highIssues.title: Inconsistent User ID Property Naming
highIssues.description: Uses req.user.id but should use req.user.userId. Inconsistent across codebase.
highIssues.impact: Undefined references causing logic errors in authorization checks
highIssues.recommendation: Standardize all code to use req.user.userId or normalize in auth middleware

highIssues.title: Silent Firebase Initialization Failures
highIssues.description: Firebase init errors return null, causing silent push notification failures
highIssues.impact: Users never receive push notifications without error visibility
highIssues.recommendation: Throw error on init failure. Queue failed notifications for retry.

highIssues.title: Multiple User ID Property Names
highIssues.description: Uses userId, id, sub - const userId = req.user.userId || req.user.id || req.user.sub
highIssues.impact: Undefined references when different properties are set in different contexts
highIssues.recommendation: Standardize to single property in auth middleware. Normalize all incoming tokens.

highIssues.title: Race Condition in Device Auto-Registration
highIssues.description: Read user, then create binding without transaction. Two simultaneous requests create duplicate bindings.
highIssues.impact: Database inconsistency, duplicate device bindings, broken relay functionality
highIssues.recommendation: Wrap in Prisma.$transaction() for atomic operation

highIssues.title: Null Reference in Safety Session Creation
highIssues.description: profile?.agencyId accessed without null check on profile
